text:
alex: Quick sync — planning a canary for speculative_decoding + kv_prefetch + enable_flash_attn on runtime. Target: 5% audience, US-only, 2h ramp. Guardrails: auto rollback if p95 latency +30% or 5xx > 0.5%. Anyone object?
maria: lgtm. Need to define canary cohort bucket ids and make sure canary excludes enterprise tenants. Can we pin to model v2.3-quant?
sam: +1. Ops: please create canary pool and add a fallback route to baseline model when specdec=off. Also need perf counters on cache-hit-ratio, specdec-fallbacks, token_p95.
jin: do we have a flag config? I'll add to flags repo and open PR. Suggest throttle for KV prefetch: max_cache_prefetch_parallelism=8 to avoid mem pressure.
carla: ops-bot created canary pool "specdec-canary-192345". Added network tag "us-west-1-canary". Also created guardrail monitors: perf.alert if p95 > 1.3x baseline OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Deploy-bot can run rollout.
deploy-bot: canary created, status: ready. Runbook: /rollouts/run --pool specdec-canary-192345 --flags '{"spec_decoding": "on", "kv_prefetch": "on", "flash_attn": "on", "kv_prefetch_parallelism": 8}' --duration 120m --audience 5%
alex: thanks. Jin pls add a short test plan in PR: 1) smoke generate 100 small prompts, 2) load test 1k qps synthetic, 3) run regression evals on our prompt-set. Also mark the PR with QA tick.
jin: will do. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/flags/pull/1123
maria: small note — enable_flash_attn is known to increase latency variance on A100 80GB in rare cases. add a plugin to monitor tail (p999) and a manual abort step for SRE.
sam: also add a feature toggle fallback path in runtime to switch off flash_attn per-request when tail spike detected. E.g. config:
```
if tail_spike_detected:
  runtime.set_kernel('flash_attn', 'off')
```
alex: perfect. I'll schedule the canary for 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC. If all green, 24h gradual ramp to 50%.
carla: noted. Anything else?
maria: ping me 10m before start, I'll watch evals.
alex: done. :thumbsup:
